name: Receipt & business card organizer
description: Parse pasted receipt lines or business card text into structured expense rows (Date, Vendor, Category, Amount, Tax) or vCard contacts locally.

seo.metaTitle: Receipt & business card organizer — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Parse pasted receipt lines or business card text into structured expense rows (Date, Vendor, Category, Amount, Tax) or vCard contacts locally. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/forms/receipt-scanner-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Receipt & business card organizer processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/forms/receipt-scanner-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Receipt & business card organizer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Receipt & business card organizer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/forms/receipt-scanner-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Receipt & business card organizer?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/receipt_scanner.json or open /tools/receipt-scanner?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
